# Charles Griffin on Fordham Law's "Bite-Sized Business Law" Podcast


February 18, 2025


-
-
-
-


[Charles Griffin](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/charles-griffin/) is this week’s guest on the “Bite-Sized Business Law” podcast, produced by Fordham Law School. Griffin discusses the state of the healthcare industry and the role of legal finance as it relates to healthcare, including a spotlight on BCBS settlement opt-outs.
